evidence: The elemental depth distributions in the coatings were analyzed by means of time of flight secondary ion mass spectroscopy (ToF-SIMS). Potentiodynamic polarization measurements were performed to analyze the corrosion protection and to quantify the coating sealing performance, in particular the uncoated surface fraction. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy was applied to characterize the coating quality. The thickness of the thinner samples was measured with X-ray reflectance (XRR).
